meta.title: Analytics
meta.description: dsh-analytics: an SPSS-style statistics workbench backed by a bundled GNU PSPP engine — data view, variable view, syntax, output viewer, analysis dialogs, and agent-readable datasets.

strings.行，这个文件里只放了前: rows; this file keeps the first
strings.行；完整数据请用「导出表格为 CSV」。: rows. Use "export table as CSV" for all of it.
strings.$q1 不是有效的变量名: $q1 is not a valid variable name
strings.Bonferroni（推荐：P × 比较对数，标记按校正后判定）: Bonferroni (recommended: P × number of comparisons; flags use the adjusted P)
strings.Cochran Q 至少需要三个变量: Cochran's Q needs at least three variables
strings.Ctrl+Enter 运行；会产生数据变更的语法请用「运行并保存数据」: Ctrl+Enter runs; syntax that changes the data should use "Run and Save Data"
strings.FILTER BY 正在生效：该变量为 0 或缺失的个案被临时排除: FILTER BY is active: cases with 0 or missing on that variable are temporarily excluded
strings.ICC 的变量里有一个在数据集中不存在: One of the ICC variables is not in the dataset
strings.ICC 至少需要两个评分者（变量），只给了一个: ICC needs at least two raters (variables); only one was given
strings.ICC 需要数值型评分，这里有字符串变量: ICC needs numeric ratings, but a string variable is present
strings.Kendall W 至少需要三个变量: Kendall's W needs at least three variables
strings.Kruskal-Wallis 需要至少两个组代码，例如 groupValues:: Kruskal-Wallis needs at least two group codes, e.g. groupValues: [1, 3]
strings.PSPP 2.1.3 在带 TOL 的回归里会报这句，但表已完整产出，结果可用: PSPP 2.1.3 prints this for regressions with TOL, but the tables are complete and usable
strings.PSPP 2.1.3 的 GLM 不接受 WITH 协变量子句。替代：用「回归: PSPP 2.1.3's GLM does not accept the WITH covariates clause. Instead use Regression → Linear with the grouping variable as dummies and the covariates as predictors; that is the ANCOVA model.
strings.PSPP 2.1.3 的 GLM 不接受协变量（WITH 子句会报语法错误），做: PSPP 2.1.3's GLM does not accept covariates (a WITH clause is a syntax error), so ANCOVA is not available: use regression, or treat the covariate as a second factor
strings.PSPP 2.1.3 返回「CURVEFIT 尚未实现」。替代：用「转换 → 计: PSPP 2.1.3 answers "CURVEFIT is not implemented". Instead build x², ln(x), 1/x with Transform → Compute Variable and run Regression → Linear.
strings.PSPP 不认 $ 变量。替代：多选题的频数与交叉表由本插件自己算——「转换 →: PSPP does not know $ variables. Multiple-response frequencies and crosstabs are therefore computed by this plugin (Transform → Multiple Response); to run other procedures, split the options into binary variables first.
strings.PSPP 只保存多选题定义、不做统计；请用「转换 → 多选题面板」看频数与交叉表: PSPP only stores multiple-response definitions and computes nothing; use Transform → Multiple Response for frequencies and crosstabs
strings.PSPP 只把定义存进字典、不会替我们算；频数与交叉表由本插件在数据上直接统计。: PSPP only stores the definition in the dictionary; it does not compute anything. Frequencies and crosstabs are counted by this plugin from the data.
strings.PSPP 有新输出（切换到「输出」查看）: New PSPP output (switch to Output to see it)
strings.SELECT IF 已经把不满足条件的个案从数据集里删除，无法用 × 取消: SELECT IF already deleted the excluded cases from the dataset; × cannot undo that
strings.SPLIT FILE 正在生效：每个结果按该变量的取值分组输出: SPLIT FILE is active: every result is produced per value of that variable
strings.WEIGHT BY 正在生效：频数/分析按该变量加权: WEIGHT BY is active: counts and analyses use that variable as weights
strings.maxExportRows 留空表示不改这一项；要设置就写 100 到 1000: maxExportRows left blank means "leave it alone"; to set it, write an integer between 100 and 100000
strings.settings.json 不是一个对象，已忽略: settings.json is not an object and was ignored
strings.↑↓ 选择 · Enter/Tab 补全 · Esc 关闭 · Ctrl+Spa: ↑↓ select · Enter/Tab accept · Esc close · Ctrl+Space open
strings.一次只能有一个分组维度：要么按类别分组，要么堆叠: Only one grouping dimension at a time: either group by category or stack
strings.上传的数据不是有效的 base64：请重新拖入文件: The uploaded data is not valid base64: drop the file again
strings.上传需要文件名: The upload needs a file name
strings.上级路径里有一段是文件: One of the parent path segments is a file
strings.下面这些值没被采用：: The following values were not used:
strings.不是一个有效的 .dta 文件（缺少 <stata_dta> 标记）: Not a valid .dta file (missing the <stata_dta> marker)
strings.不是一个有效的 .ods 文件（不是 ZIP 容器）: Not a valid .ods file (not a ZIP container)
strings.不是一个有效的 .xlsx 文件（找不到 ZIP 目录）: Not a valid .xlsx file (ZIP directory not found)
strings.不校正（只在明确需要原始 P 时用）: No adjustment (only when the raw P is really wanted)
strings.不满足条件的个案会被从数据集中删除: Cases that do not match are deleted from the dataset
strings.与表 1 相同，但去掉「总体」列。: Same as Table 1, without the Total column.
strings.两个变量不能是同一个: The two variables must be different
strings.两个变量都必须是二分类（同一批个案前后两次测量）；报告的是不一致格的精确检验。: Both variables must be binary (two measurements on the same cases); the exact test on the discordant cells is reported.
strings.中位数（四分位数间距）（P 仍用 t / F，仅供描述）: Median (interquartile range) (P still from t / F; descriptive only)
strings.二分法（每个变量是一个是/否题，勾选的算一次）: Dichotomy (each variable is a yes/no item; a counted value counts once)
strings.从该分组变量的观测值里选两个；没有可选值时手填: Pick two observed values of the grouping variable; type them when none are available
strings.从输出里删除这一项（不改变数据）: Remove this item from the output (the data is untouched)
strings.例；分析、保存与导出仍在完整数据上跑: cases; analyses, saving and export still use the full data
strings.保存后这张表按新排版显示，导出 HTML 时一并生效；导出的 Word/Exce: After saving, this table is shown with the new layout, and HTML export follows it; Word/Excel export still writes PSPP's original table.
strings.保留原有标签（只覆盖本次出现的值）: Keep existing labels (only the listed values are overwritten)
strings.偏相关至少需要两个分析变量: Partial correlation needs at least two analysis variables
strings.偏相关：把两个变量分别对控制变量做线性回归，再求两组残差的 Pearson 相关: Partial correlation: regress both variables on the controls, then take the Pearson correlation of the two residuals; P comes from t = r·√(df/(1-r²)) with df = valid N − controls − 2
strings.允许的目录必须是一个字符串数组，或者一行一个目录的文本: allowedDirs must be an array of strings, or text with one directory per line
strings.允许读写哪些目录（每行一个）: Directories this plugin may read and write (one per line)
strings.先在左侧点一个变量: Click a variable on the left first
strings.先在左边选要合并的变量: Pick the variables to merge on the left first
strings.先在数据视图里选中一个单元格: Select a cell in Data View first
strings.先把左边必填的变量选上，这里会显示「确定」将要执行的语法。: Pick the required variables on the left; the syntax that OK will run appears here.
strings.共线性诊断（容忍度 / VIF，由插件计算）: Collinearity diagnostics (tolerance / VIF, computed by the plugin)
strings.内置 PSPP 引擎 + SPSS 风格工作台；统计过程由 PSPP 执行。: Bundled PSPP engine with an SPSS-style workbench; PSPP runs the statistical procedures.
strings.出错后引擎停止了后面的语句，下面的结果可能不完整: The engine stopped after the error, so the results below may be incomplete
strings.分类变量按 n（%）列出，P 值用 Pearson 卡方。: Categorical variables are listed as n (%), with Pearson chi-square P values.
strings.分组变量不会同时作为分析变量（已自动略过）。: The grouping variable is not used as an analysis variable (skipped automatically).
strings.分组变量与堆叠变量不能是同一个: The grouping and stacking variables must differ
strings.列变量含缺失值类别: Include the missing-value category in the column variable
strings.列设置（表头文字 / 列宽像素，留空则自动）: Column settings (header text / width in px; blank means auto)
strings.加入 / 移出这个框: Add to / remove from this box
strings.原始个案会作为一张隐藏工作表附在文件末尾；报告里没打印的量（均数、标准差）可以用: The raw cases ride along as a hidden sheet at the end of the file; quantities the report omits (mean, standard deviation) can be computed with AVERAGE / STDEV.S. Off by default; leave it off with sensitive data.
strings.双 Y 轴折线图的两个变量都没有有效数据: Neither variable of the dual-axis line chart has valid data
strings.双 Y 轴折线图需要第二个变量（y2）: The dual-axis line chart needs a second variable (y2)
strings.变量名不能为空: The variable name cannot be empty
strings.变量必须是二分变量（两个不同取值）: The variable must be binary (two distinct values)
strings.只把这一张图导成 .docx 或 .xlsx（Word 里是内嵌图片，Excel: Export just this chart to .docx or .xlsx (an inline picture in Word, its own sheet in Excel)
strings.只把这一张表导成 .docx 或 .xlsx（按文件名后缀决定格式）: Export just this table to .docx or .xlsx (the file extension picks the format)
strings.只能是 three-line 或 grid，收到: must be three-line or grid, got
strings.只能是 true 或 false，收到: must be true or false, got
strings.只能是 zh 或 en，收到: must be zh or en, got
strings.同表没有 Fisher 行：重跑时把统计量里的卡方（CHISQ）勾上，2×2 时: This table has no Fisher row: tick chi-square (CHISQ) under statistics and rerun; for 2×2 tables PSPP adds a Fisher's Exact Test row by itself
strings.图表只能导出为 .png 或 .svg: Charts can only be exported as .png or .svg
strings.在此输入 PSPP 语法或导入 sps 语法文件，例如：\nFREQUENCIE:
Type PSPP syntax here or import an .sps file, for example:
FREQUENCIES /VARIABLES=gender.

Ctrl+Enter runs it
strings.均数±标准差（P 用 t 检验 / 方差分析）: Mean ± SD (P from t test / ANOVA)
strings.处理来路不明的数据时打开。下一次运行生效。: Turn on for data of unknown origin. Takes effect on the next run.
strings.多分类要写出计数哪些值，例如 1 2 3: List the counted values for multiple categories, e.g. 1 2 3
strings.多分类（同一组值出现在多个变量里，例如第一/第二/第三选择）: Multiple categories (the same values appear across variables, e.g. first/second/third choice)
strings.多选题直接进 CROSSTABS 等过程: Multiple-response sets go straight into CROSSTABS and friends
strings.多选题至少要选两个变量: Multiple response needs at least two variables
strings.字典里没有这个变量：先确认变量名，或它在上一步已经被删除/改名: The dictionary has no such variable: check the name, or it was deleted/renamed by an earlier step
strings.容忍度 = 1 − R²（该预测变量对其余预测变量回归）；VIF = 1 / 容: Tolerance = 1 − R² (this predictor regressed on the others); VIF = 1 / tolerance. Tolerance < 0.1 (VIF > 10) usually means clear collinearity
strings.宿主返回的数据形状不认识：需要 { ok:true, state:{…} }，或: The host returned a shape this panel does not know: expected { ok:true, state:{…} } or the state object itself
strings.对这几个变量做两两比较（Welch t，默认 Bonferroni）: Pairwise comparisons over these variables (Welch t, Bonferroni by default)
strings.导入时哪些列名被改过、原名保存在哪里: Which column names were changed on import, and where the originals live
strings.导入说明：列名为什么改了: Import notes: why the column names changed
strings.导出上限立即生效（面板、Word、Excel、HTML 四个出口同一数值）：频率: The export cap takes effect immediately (one number for the panel, Word, Excel and HTML): a frequency table with one row per value easily runs to thousands of rows, and an export that hits the cap says in the file that only the first N rows were kept.
strings.导出为 PNG（几何与颜色精确，标签请在图下写）: Export as PNG (exact geometry and colour; write the labels below the chart)
strings.导出时每张表最多放多少行: Maximum rows per table on export
strings.导出格式只能是 .pdf、.odt 或 .spv: The export format must be .pdf, .odt or .spv
strings.已保存。界面语言、表格样式、允许的目录、导出上限立即生效；载入上限与超时在下一次: Saved. Language, table style, allowed directories and the export cap take effect immediately; the case cap and timeout take effect next time.
strings.已按「数据视图最多载入个案数」只显示前: Only the first N cases are shown, per the data-view load cap:
strings.引擎打印的容忍度不可用（PSPP 在退化拟合下会写成 .00 / +Infini: The tolerance PSPP printed is unusable (it writes .00 / +Infinit on degenerate fits), so it was replaced by "—"; the correct values are under Collinearity diagnostics (computed by the plugin)
strings.引擎跑得比这个久就中止。下一次运行生效。: The run is aborted past this. Takes effect on the next run.
strings.所有个案的总分完全相同（个案间均方为 0），ICC 无定义: Every case has the same total score (between-case mean square is 0), so ICC is undefined
strings.所有评分完全一致（误差均方为 0），ICC 无定义；这种情况通常用 Kappa: All ratings agree exactly (error mean square is 0), so ICC is undefined; Kappa is usually the better statistic here
strings.打不开这个文件：它不在这个位置了: Cannot open this file: it is no longer at that location
strings.打不开这个文件：它正被其他程序占用（Excel/Word/另一个 DSH 会话）: Cannot open this file: another program is holding it (Excel/Word/another DSH session), or there is no read permission
strings.打不开这个文件：引擎没有给出原因: Cannot open this file: the engine gave no reason
strings.找到后跳到数据视图里的那个单元格。: Jump to that cell in Data View when found.
strings.把对方文件的个案追加到当前数据末尾（ADD FILES）。: Append the other file's cases to the end of the current data (ADD FILES).
strings.把对方文件的变量按键变量匹配到当前数据（MATCH FILES /BY）。: Match the other file's variables onto the current data by key (MATCH FILES /BY).
strings.把对话框恢复成刚打开时的样子: Restore this dialog to how it looked when opened
strings.把这次设置生成的语法放进语法编辑器，不运行: Put the syntax these settings generate into the syntax editor without running it
strings.折线图和面积图需要再加一个类别变量：先选一列，或改用「折线图…」对话框: Line and area charts need a category variable too: select a column, or use the Line Chart dialog
strings.报告卡里还没有可导出的内容：先勾选几个结果: The report card has nothing to export yet: tick a few results first
strings.报告卡里还没有可重放的语法: The report card has no syntax to replay yet
strings.抽样比例需为 1–100 之间的数字: The sampling fraction must be a number between 1 and 100
strings.拖动左侧把手调整变量顺序（数据视图的列顺序跟着变）；双击单元格编辑；拖动表头右边: Drag the left handle to reorder variables (Data View columns follow); double-click a cell to edit; drag a header's right edge to resize.
strings.指定的输出条目已经不在了：刷新面板后重新选择: That output item is gone: refresh the panel and pick again
strings.按勾选顺序重放这些分析，导出成文档: Replay the ticked analyses in order and export them as a document
strings.按近似比例抽取个案；结果直接写回数据集（不可撤销）: Draw an approximate fraction of cases; the result is written back to the dataset (cannot be undone)
strings.控制变量（可空，选中的变量的影响会被剔除）: Control variables (may be empty; their effect is removed)
strings.改列宽、表头文字、加脚注（三线表排版用）: Change widths, header text and footnotes (for the three-line layout)
strings.改标题、配色与类别排序: Change the title, colours and category order
strings.数值为均数差（左组 − 右组），星号为未校正 P：*** <0.001，** <: Values are mean differences (left − right); asterisks are uncorrected P: *** <0.001, ** <0.01, * <0.05; ns is not flagged
strings.数值会按同一份数据重新计算，改的只是外观与排序。: The numbers are recomputed from the same data; only the look and the order change.
strings.数值写法不合法：检查括号里的取值或格式: Invalid number syntax: check the values or the format inside the parentheses
strings.数值变量的替换只改整格；文本变量按子串替换。: Numeric replacements change whole cells only; text variables are replaced by substring.
strings.数据不足以估计共线性，所有单元格为「—」: Not enough data to estimate collinearity; every cell is "—"
strings.数据视图最多载入个案数: Maximum cases loaded into Data View
strings.数据视图正在显示值标签，点一下改显示原始数值: Data View shows value labels; click to show the raw values
strings.数据视图正在显示原始数值，点一下改显示值标签: Data View shows raw values; click to show value labels
strings.数据集已关闭：撤销记录随之失效: The dataset was closed, so the undo history went with it
strings.数据集较大，撤销记录超出内存预算：最早的: Large dataset: the undo history went past its memory budget, the earliest
strings.文件名太长，超过系统的上限: The file name is too long for the system limit
strings.文件太大（上限 4 MB）: The file is too large (4 MB limit)
strings.文件打不开：确认路径存在；Windows 上路径含中文时旧版引擎会读不到，本插件: Cannot open the file: check the path exists; on Windows older engines cannot read paths with Chinese characters, which this plugin already works around
strings.新建变量（转到变量视图最后一行）: New variable (jumps to the last row of Variable View)
strings.显著性矩阵需要一个分组变量（group）: The significance matrix needs a grouping variable (group)
strings.暂不支持大端（MSF）的 .dta 文件: Big-endian (MSF) .dta files are not supported yet
strings.最近一次运行 = 最后生成的那批表/图，例如刚做的两两比较或表 1: Latest run = the most recent batch of tables/charts, e.g. the pairwise comparisons you just ran or Table 1
strings.松开即可打开这个数据文件: Release to open this data file
strings.查找内容不能为空: Nothing to find: the search text is empty
strings.格式由扩展名决定；源文件是当前数据集（必要时先写回 work.sav）: The extension picks the format; the source is the current dataset (written back to work.sav first when needed)
strings.模型只有一个预测变量，容忍度恒为 1、VIF 恒为 1；PSPP 自己在这种情况: The model has a single predictor, so tolerance is 1 and VIF is 1; PSPP itself prints +Infinit or NaN here
strings.正在运行分析或载入数据，现在不能改：等这次运行结束再编辑（输出视图里能看到进度）: An analysis or a data load is running, so nothing can be edited now: wait for it to finish (the output view shows progress)
strings.正在运行分析或载入数据，现在不能清除输出：等这次运行结束再清（输出视图里能看到进: An analysis or a data load is running, so the output cannot be cleared now: wait for it to finish (the output view shows progress)
strings.每一对组做 Welch t 检验，不要求方差齐；矩阵表适合多组论文排版。: Welch t tests for every group pair, so equal variances are not assumed; the matrix table suits multi-group papers.
strings.每个变量对做一次：两个变量分别对控制变量回归，再求残差的相关（PSPP 没有 P: One per variable pair: regress both variables on the controls, then correlate the residuals (PSPP has no PARTIAL CORR, so this plugin computes the table).
strings.每对用 Welch t 检验，不要求方差齐；「—」表示该组不足 2 个个案: Welch t tests for every pair, so equal variances are not assumed; "—" means that group has fewer than 2 cases
strings.每行「值,标签」（或「标签,值」），也可以直接粘贴 VALUE LABELS 语: One "value,label" per line (or "label,value"); a VALUE LABELS statement may be pasted directly.
strings.每行一个：值=标签。保存后数据视图显示标签，写回数据文件时写入 VALUE LA: One per line: value=label. Data View then shows labels, and saving writes VALUE LABELS.
strings.没有可分析的有效个案：检查筛选条件、缺失值定义，或变量是否全为空: No valid cases to analyse: check the filters, the missing-value definitions, or whether the variables are entirely empty
strings.没有可导出的表格：重新点一次「导出 CSV…」: No table to export: click "Export CSV…" again
strings.没有指定控制变量，这里的 r 就是普通的 Pearson 相关；P 来自 t =: No control variables were given, so r is an ordinary Pearson correlation; P comes from t = r·√(df/(1-r²)) with df = valid N − 2
strings.没有数值变量：多选题只能用数值变量: No numeric variables: multiple response needs numeric variables
strings.没有权限访问这个路径：目录是只读的、属于另一个用户，或者文件正被其他程序占用: No permission for this path: the directory is read-only, belongs to another user, or the file is held by another program
strings.没有要追加的个案: There are no cases to append
strings.没有计算 ICC：这段语法里有会改数据或换数据的命令，引擎用的是改过之后的数据，: ICC was not computed: this syntax contains commands that change or replace the data, so the engine worked on modified data while the plugin still holds the current dataset. Run RELIABILITY on its own (without those commands) to get the ICC
strings.没有这条命令：检查命令拼写（PSPP 与 SPSS 的命令集不完全相同）: No such command: check the spelling (PSPP and SPSS do not share every command)
strings.点击放大；双击编辑标题、配色与排序: Click to enlarge; double-click to edit the title, colours and order
strings.用 --safer 运行（禁用写入文件与外部命令）: Run with --safer (no file writes, no external commands)
strings.用空格或逗号分隔；区间写成 90 THRU 99: Separate with spaces or commas; write ranges as 90 THRU 99
strings.用这次模型的因变量做状态变量、第一个协变量做检验变量，画出 ROC 曲线: Use this model's dependent variable as the state variable and its first covariate as the test variable, then draw the ROC curve
strings.由引擎自带的 pspp-convert 完成，不经过语法解析。: Done by the engine's own pspp-convert, without parsing syntax.
strings.留空则保留原样: Leave blank to keep as is
strings.留空并确定表示清除筛选。: Leave blank and press OK to clear the filter.
strings.留空表示在所有变量里查找: Leave blank to search every variable
strings.目标文件已存在：换一个文件名，或先删掉旧文件: The target file already exists: pick another name, or delete the old file first
strings.目标路径需要扩展名，例如 .csv / .por / .dta: The target path needs an extension, e.g. .csv / .por / .dta
strings.矩阵奇异：自变量之间存在完全共线，或样本量太小: The matrix is singular: the predictors are perfectly collinear, or the sample is too small
